units.subject: READING
units.title: Tricky Words
units.description: Common words that do not follow the usual sounds.

skills.title: Tricky words: said, was, they, have

activities.title: Tricky words
activities.instructions: These words are tricky. Learn them by heart.

questions.body: The ai says /e/ in this word. Mom said yes.
questions.speech: said. The {@a} {@i} says {/EH/} in this word. Mom said yes.

questions.body: The ey says /ay/. They are my friends.
